description:
Use this when you need an Ireland national statutory public-holiday result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need an employer, bank, school, sector, local or individually selected benefit day.
What it computes: Checks an Ireland date against the Saturday-Sunday baseline and exact 2026-2027 national statutory public holidays. Good Friday is a normal working day and weekend holidays are not automatically moved to Monday.
Example user requests: Is 2027-02-01 an Ireland working day?
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2027-02-01"} | {"date":"2027-03-26"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, holiday_names, calendar_scope, good_friday_policy, weekend_holiday_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = Monday-Friday and no exact national statutory public holiday
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/ireland-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/ireland-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in Ireland national 2026-2027 coverage.

name: check_ireland_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: National statutory public holidays over a Monday-Friday baseline.

good_friday_policy.description: Good Friday is not a public holiday.

holiday_names.description: National statutory public holidays applying on the date.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no national statutory public holiday.

sources.description: Official Irish government regulator and legislation sources.

weekend_holiday_policy.description: No automatic next-working-day closure is inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Ireland Working Day
